purpose: One canonical transliteration per person/place; used everywhere in app text, HUD labels, and captions. Reject-list spellings must never appear in rendered blocks. All names are HISTORY-tagged material.

conventions.honorifics: Prophet Muhammad = the Prophet (PBUH); Companions first mention per block carries (may Allah be pleased with him/her) - the table below lists bare names for label efficiency.
conventions.diacritics: Diacritics allowed in ornamental titles only; on-screen UI text uses bare ASCII forms from 'canonical'.
